    Key Features

    Targeted Relief: Designed to ease neck and shoulder tension, while also helping with lower back pain, knots, traps, hip discomfort, migraines, tension headaches, clenched jaw, and more.

    Therapeutic Heat: Enhances relaxation and promotes muscle recovery.

    Customizable Modes: Choose from kneading, shiatsu, and rolling massage settings.

    Portable & Versatile: Lightweight design for use at home, work, or travel.

    Safety First: Auto shut-off after 10 minutes for worry-free use.

    info_i

    About this item

    Comfort You Can Trust: Relaxation made easy with smart technology that adjusts to you. 95% of users felt pain relief* and 80% preferred ours** compared to their massager.

    *Based on 187 user perception surveys. **Based on 160 user perception surveys.

    Human-Like Massage Relief: TheraPexa utilizes squeezing, kneading, and push-and-roll hand massage techniques to deliver comprehensive, human-inspired massages.

    Auto-Adaptive Fit: Powered by a built-in Hall sensor, in Mode 1 the massager detects your neck width and automatically adjusts head spacing and pressure within 3–5 seconds, providing a comfortable, personalized fit for neck sizes between 11.8" and 16.5".

    Adaptive Massage Modes: 3 massage modes target common neck & shoulder tension areas. Select the mode that suits you best — Gentle (full-coverage relaxation), Moderate (neck-focused comfort), and Deep (trapezius-targeted massage).

    Quick & Soothing Warmth: Heated massage heads add warmth that feels like a hot stone massage. Reaches 104°–113°F for long-lasting comfort you can begin to feel in under 1 minute.

    Cordless & Effortless: Enjoy comfort wherever you like. Strap it, pull it, and wear it your way. Cordless and rechargeable with up to 350 minutes of use per charge. Comes with a carrying bag so you can relax anytime, anywhere.

    chat

    How to Use

    TheraPexa Neck & Shoulder Massager

    3 Massage Modes:

    • Soothing Mode – Gentle, relaxing massage for neck, shoulders & back
    • Strength Mode – Intense kneading & rolling for deep muscle relief
    • Deep Kneading Mode - Strong deep kneading massage for deeper knots and muscle relief

    2 Heat Levels:

    • Level 1 (40°C/104°F) – Warm compress for light relaxation
    • Level 2 (45°C/113°F) – Deep heat therapy for muscle relief

    2 Intensity/Speed Levels

    • Low Speed – A slower, more gentle massage that's perfect for relaxing tight muscles and winding down.
    • High Speed – A faster, more invigorating massage to help deeply target and relieve knots and tension.

    Easily adjust intensity and heat for a personalized massage. Its sleek, compact design makes it perfect for home, car, or office use...bringing relaxation anywhere you go

                Frequently Asked Questions

                help

                How does the TheraPexa Neck & Shoulder massager work?

                This massager utilizes innovative massage nodes that target specific pressure points in your neck and shoulders. The gentle heat feature enhances blood circulation, promoting relaxation and relief from muscle tension.

                help

                Can I adjust the massage intensity?

                Absolutely! Our massager offers customizable massage modes and intensity levels, allowing you to find the perfect setting for your comfort and preferences.

                help

                How Long Does The Battery Last?

                The battery runs for 60-90 minutes and charges extremely quick through USB Type-C!

                Rest assured with 10 min auto-off and overheat protection (when heated) for a safe and comforting massage session.

                help

                Does this massager help with lymphatic drainage?

                Yes, while this massager is not a medical lymphatic drainage device, its deep kneading and soothing heat can help stimulate circulation and support natural lymph flow. Regular use may help reduce fluid buildup, ease muscle tension, and promote your body’s natural detox process.

                help

                How do I know when it's been charged?

                The TheraPexa Neck & Shoulder Massager features a charging indicator light that turns a blinking red during the charging process and switches to a slow blinking white when fully charged. After fully charged, it is recommended to unplug the power supply.

                Please note that it cannot be used while charging, as it activates a self-protection program to ensure proper functioning during the charging process.

                help

                How long should I use the massager for each session?

                For optimal results and safety, We recommend starting with 10 minute periods a day and take proper rest after each 10 minute session. If desired, you can enjoy multiple sessions throughout the day, but always remember to take short breaks between each use.

                help

                Is the massager suitable for individuals with certain medical conditions?

                While our massager is generally safe and beneficial for most individuals, we recommend consulting with a healthcare professional before use if you have specific medical conditions, such as injuries, chronic pain, or certain medical implants.

                help

                Is the massager cordless?

                Yes, our neck and shoulder massager is designed to be lightweight and portable. Its compact size and cordless design allows you to take it with you on trips, to the office, or wherever you need a relaxing break.

                help

                Do you sell on Amazon?

                We do not sell on Amazon at the moment. Any listings that appear under the TheraPexa name on Amazon are not affiliated with us and misrepresent our brand. These listings are from third-party resellers in China who use our name and images without permission.

                The massagers sold there are knockoffs and are not our authentic TheraPexa Neck and Shoulder Massager. We cannot guarantee their quality, safety, or warranty coverage.

                Our genuine TheraPexa products are only available through our official website, and all orders are shipped directly from our warehouse in Dallas, Texas for fast and reliable delivery with full warranty protection.

                help

                How can I contact the company?

                Please reach out to us using the contact tab on our website or emailing us - support@therapexa.com
